comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Sample set demonstrates thorough exploration across all required tables with varied multiplier-multiplicand pairings (1 through 9 as first operand, 1 through 10 as second operand), multiple response formats (four types: multiple choice, true/false, error detection, fill-in-blank), and both monetary and non-monetary problem contexts with strategic inclusion of edge cases like multiplication by 1.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Product magnitudes appropriately constrained between 2 and 80, remaining well within Grade 2 multiplication scope. Money amounts denominated in reasonable Philippine pesos (₱2 to ₱4 per unit) make real-world application plausible. Object quantities in contextual scenarios stay within typical Grade 2 manipulatives and counting ranges.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Response formats span four distinct types with 22 samples distributed as: 8 multiple-choice items with various distractors, 7 true/false items with incorrect statements, 5 fill-in-blank problems, and 6 error-detection scenarios identifying incorrect student work. Experience modes vary (standard, hint_gated, mastery_drill, scaffolded) providing instructional differentiation. Hints employ multiple pedagogical strategies: additive decomposition, repeated addition grouping, and formal multiplication notation.
